prompt: Two concert tickets plus a $\$6$ service fee cost $\$96$ in total. Solve $2t + 6 = 96$ to find the price $t$ of one ticket in dollars. Give just the number.
hint: The fee was added after the two tickets were counted. Remove the last thing that was done first.

hints.text: The fee was added after the two tickets were counted. Remove the last thing that was done first.
Subtract the $6$ from both sides to get $2t = 90$. Then divide both sides by $2$.

explanation: Take the service fee off both sides first: $2t = 96 - 6 = 90$, the cost of the tickets alone.
Two tickets cost $90$, so divide both sides by $2$ to find one ticket: $t = 45$.
Check: $2(45) + 6 = 90 + 6 = 96$, so each ticket costs $45$ dollars.

alternativeExplanations.title: As a balance scale
steps: Left pan: two ticket-boxes and a $\$6$ weight. Right pan: $\$96$.
Lift the $\$6$ off each pan: two boxes balance $\$90$.
Split each pan in half: one box balances $\$45$.
